title: Bosun Archetype 5: Sovereign Vault Contract v1
description: Base archetype contract for metadata wrapper paired with encrypted binary payloads, key verification hashes, and delegation parameters. Embeds the universal $pkm meta-envelope.

title.description: Human-readable label for the vault secret or record.

vault_metadata.description: Classification and environment metadata for the sovereign vault entry.

encrypted_payload.description: Encrypted binary payload and cipher parameters.

ciphertext_cas.description: Content-addressed storage URI/hash of the encrypted binary payload.

tag.description: Authentication tag for authenticated encryption modes.

key_verification.description: Key verification hashes and cryptographic identity bindings.

key_hash_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the public key or recipient key material.

key_id.description: Identifier for the decryption key or HSM token.

delegation.description: Delegation parameters governing access delegation and capability tokens.

delegated_to.description: Identities or public key fingerprints granted delegated access.

expiry.description: ISO-8601 expiration timestamp of the delegation grant.

delegation_signature.description: Cryptographic signature certifying the delegation parameters.

pkmEnvelope.description: Universal Meta-Envelope ($pkm namespace) identifying the entity, canonical realm, timestamps, and typed relations.

id.description: UUIDv7 URN uniquely identifying this entity.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC date-time string (Postel coercion: permissive ingestion of date strings missing seconds).

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC date-time string (Postel coercion: permissive ingestion of date strings missing seconds).

schema.description: Harbormaster locker-note schema prefix ($<realm>:<type>/v1). Optional. Used with a top-level note id when $pkm.id is omitted.

urn.description: Optional explicit entity URN. Harbormaster graph_query prefers this over reconstructing urn:<realm>:<type>:<id>.

relations.description: Either a typed verb map (canonical relations.schema.json) or an array of {target,type} edges (harbormaster locker notes / older yeoman interaction form).

oneOf.description: Map of typed predicate verbs to URN strings or URN arrays.
Edge list used by harbormaster locker notes.
